ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Banksy's New Work in Port Talbot

fullPassage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a (A)[concrete / abstract] block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching (B)[snowflakes / raindrops] with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to (C)[ash / snow] coming from a dumpster fire.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 콘크리트 블록 차고에 나타나며, 아이가 눈송이를 잡고 있지만 실제로는 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재를 향해 입을 벌리고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① concrete — snowflakes — ash
❌ ② abstract — snowflakes — snow
❌ ③ concrete — raindrops — snow
❌ ④ abstract — raindrops — ash
✅ (A) concrete: 콘크리트 블록 차고. (B) snowflakes: 눈송이를 잡는 아이. (C) ash: 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재.
det.tip: concrete(콘크리트) ↔ abstract(추상적). snowflakes(눈송이) ↔ raindrops(빗방울). ash(재) ↔ snow(눈).

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot (A)[resident / tourist], to create art that would (B)[highlight / conceal] Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health (C)[risks / benefits] by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Port Talbot의 주민이 먼지 문제를 부각하기 위해 예술 작품을 의뢰했으며, 아이들이 건강 위험에 직면하고 있다고 믿었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① resident — highlight — risks
❌ ② tourist — highlight — benefits
❌ ③ resident — conceal — benefits
❌ ④ tourist — conceal — risks
✅ (A) resident: 주민. (B) highlight: 부각하다. (C) risks: 건강 위험.
det.tip: resident(주민) ↔ tourist(관광객). highlight(부각하다) ↔ conceal(숨기다). risks(위험) ↔ benefits(이점).

questions.passage: Children are particularly (A)[defenseless / resistant] against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more (B)[pollutants / nutrients]. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in (C)[toxic / fresh] air every day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 대기 오염에 특히 무방비하며, 더 많은 오염 물질을 흡입하고, 유독한 공기를 매일 마신다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① defenseless — pollutants — toxic
❌ ② resistant — pollutants — fresh
❌ ③ defenseless — nutrients — fresh
❌ ④ resistant — nutrients — toxic
✅ (A) defenseless: 무방비한. (B) pollutants: 오염 물질. (C) toxic: 유독한.
det.tip: defenseless(무방비) ↔ resistant(저항력 있는). pollutants(오염물질) ↔ nutrients(영양소). toxic(유독한) ↔ fresh(신선한).

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health ①<u>risks</u> by playing in the dust coming from the local steel ②<u>plant</u>. Children are particularly ③<u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in ④<u>fewer</u> pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 호흡 속도가 빠르므로 오염 물질을 더 많이(more) 흡입한다. fewer(더 적은)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①risks: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②plant: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③defenseless: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④fewer: 원문은 more. 호흡 속도가 빠르면 오염물질을 더 많이 들이마심.
det.tip: more(더 많은) ↔ fewer(더 적은). 빠른 호흡 속도 → 더 많은 오염물질 흡입.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would ①<u>highlight</u> Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing ②<u>serious</u> health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. Children are particularly ③<u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more ④<u>nutrients</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 더 많은 오염 물질(pollutants)을 흡입한다. nutrients(영양소)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①highlight: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②serious: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③defenseless: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④nutrients: 원문은 pollutants. 대기 오염 맥락에서 영양소는 맞지 않음.
det.tip: pollutants(오염 물질) ↔ nutrients(영양소). 대기 오염 맥락 주의.

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included ①<u>environmental</u> messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was ②<u>trees</u>." According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in ③<u>toxic</u> air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children ④<u>recovered</u> from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 약 60만 명의 아이들이 오염된 공기에 노출되어 사망(died)했다. recovered(회복했다)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①environmental: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②trees: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③toxic: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④recovered: 원문은 died. 오염 공기의 심각한 결과 강조.
det.tip: died(사망했다) ↔ recovered(회복했다). 대기 오염의 치명적 결과를 부각하는 맥락.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a __________. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모퉁이를 돌면, 아이 입이 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재를 향하고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②dumpster fire: 원문 그대로. ❌ ①steel plant: 2단락에 등장하나 이 맥락에서는 dumpster fire가 맞음. ❌ ③coal mine: 탄광은 원문에 없음. ❌ ④factory chimney: 공장 굴뚝은 원문에 없음.
det.tip: dumpster fire: 쓰레기통 불. Banksy 작품의 핵심 이미지.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. Children are particularly __________ against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 대기 오염에 특히 무방비하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③defenseless: 원문 그대로. 호흡 속도가 빠르므로 오염에 취약. ❌ ①aggressive(공격적): 무관. ❌ ②indifferent(무관심한): 무관. ❌ ④responsible(책임 있는): 무관.
det.tip: defenseless: 무방비한, 방어할 수 없는. against와 함께 쓰임.

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from __________ to polluted air. Banksy's art has included environmental messages before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 약 60만 명의 아이들이 오염된 공기에 노출되어 사망했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④exposure: 원문 그대로. died from exposure to = ~에 노출되어 사망. ❌ ①addiction(중독): 의미 부적절. ❌ ②resistance(저항): 반대 의미. ❌ ③adaptation(적응): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: exposure: 노출. 'exposure to polluted air' = 오염된 공기에 대한 노출.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would <u>highlight</u> Port Talbot's dust problem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'highlight'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Port Talbot의 먼지 문제를 부각하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①emphasize: highlight ≈ emphasize(강조하다). ❌ ②ignore(무시하다): 반대. ❌ ③create(만들다): 다른 의미. ❌ ④resolve(해결하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: highlight: 부각하다, 강조하다. ≈ emphasize, draw attention to.

questions.passage: In 2016, the WHO even <u>estimated</u> that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'estimated'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: WHO는 약 60만 명의 아이들이 사망했다고 추정했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③calculated: estimated ≈ calculated(산출하다, 계산하다). ❌ ①confirmed(확인하다): 확정이 아닌 추정. ❌ ②denied(부인하다): 반대. ❌ ④imagined(상상하다): 무관.
det.tip: estimate: 추정하다, 어림잡다. ≈ calculate, approximate.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy <u>designed</u> another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'designed'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Banksy가 또 다른 흥미로운 예술 작품을 디자인했다/만들었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②created: designed ≈ created(만들다). ❌ ①destroyed(파괴하다): 반대. ❌ ③purchased(구매하다): 다른 의미. ❌ ④discovered(발견하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: design: 디자인하다, 설계하다. ≈ create, devise.

questions.passage: Children are particularly <u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'defenseless'와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 대기 오염에 무방비하다 ↔ 보호받는.
det.analysis: ✅ ④protected: defenseless(무방비한)의 반의어. ❌ ①vulnerable(취약한): 유의어. ❌ ②helpless(무력한): 유의어. ❌ ③exposed(노출된): 유의어.
det.tip: defenseless(무방비한) ↔ protected(보호받는). 나머지는 모두 defenseless와 유사.

questions.passage: According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in <u>toxic</u> air every day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'toxic'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 유독한 공기 ↔ 무해한 공기.
det.analysis: ✅ ②harmless: toxic(유독한)의 반의어. ❌ ①poisonous(독이 있는): 유의어. ❌ ③deadly(치명적인): 유의어. ❌ ④dangerous(위험한): 유의어.
det.tip: toxic(유독한) ↔ harmless(무해한). 나머지는 모두 toxic과 유사한 부정적 의미.

questions.passage:
(A) Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel <u>plant</u>.

(B) Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a <u>plant</u> in Detroit.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 'plant'의 의미를 가장 잘 나타낸 것은?

det.korean: (A) 지역 철강 공장에서 나오는 먼지. (B) 디트로이트의 공장 잔해.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 식물 — (B) 식물
❌ ② (A) 공장 — (B) 식물
✅ ③ (A) 공장 — (B) 공장
❌ ④ (A) 식물 — (B) 공장
✅ ③ (A)공장: steel plant = 철강 공장. (B)공장: remains of a plant = 공장의 잔해. 두 곳 모두 산업 시설 의미.
det.tip: plant: ①식물 ②공장/발전소. 여기서는 둘 다 '공장' 의미. steel plant(철강 공장).

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the condition of being subjected to something harmful or unpleasant"

det.korean: "해롭거나 불쾌한 것에 노출되는 상태" = 노출.
det.analysis: ✅ ②exposure: 노출. 정의와 정확히 일치. ❌ ①pollution(오염): 오염 자체. ❌ ③environment(환경): 무관. ❌ ④resident(주민): 무관.
det.tip: exposure: 노출. 본문 'died from exposure to polluted air'에서 등장.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The government should take __________ (act) to reduce air pollution in industrial areas.

det.korean: 정부는 산업 지역의 대기 오염을 줄이기 위한 조치를 취해야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ action: take __________ → take action. act(동사) → action(명사).
det.tip: act(동사: 행동하다) → action(명사: 행동, 조치). take action = 조치를 취하다.

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The factory was shut down because of the __________ (pollute) it was causing in the nearby river.

det.korean: 공장은 인근 강에 야기하고 있던 오염 때문에 폐쇄되었다.
det.analysis: ✅ pollution: the __________ → 관사 뒤 명사 필요. pollute(동사) → pollution(명사).
det.tip: pollute(동사: 오염시키다) → pollution(명사: 오염). pollutant(명사: 오염 물질)도 구분.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to __________. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: ash coming from a dumpster fire

det.korean: 모퉁이를 돌면, 아이의 입이 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재를 향하고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 원문 그대로. 눈송이가 아닌 재라는 반전. ❌ ①: 깨끗한 공기가 아님. ❌ ②: 빗방울이 아님. ❌ ④: steel plant 먼지는 2단락에서 등장.
det.tip: however: 반전 신호. 눈송이 → 실제로는 재.

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "__________." This message highlighted the loss of natural areas to industrial development.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: I remember when all this was trees

det.korean: "이 모든 것이 나무였을 때를 기억한다."
det.analysis: ✅ ②: 원문 그대로. 공장 잔해에서 과거의 자연을 회상. ❌ ①③④: 원문에 없는 문구.
det.tip: I remember when: ~였을 때를 기억한다. 자연 파괴에 대한 환경 메시지.
